programme: ShotSight Virtual Shooter — Learn to Shoot
governing_rule: ORACLE KNOWS. SHOOTER PERCEIVES, BELIEVES, ACTS, REMEMBERS AND LEARNS.

l0_reference.interpretation: Engineering ceiling and weak lower baseline only; not human performance or real break probability.

l1_reference.interpretation: L1 architecture is complete; poor-view ambiguity is real and later stages must price observation time against shooting opportunity.

l2_presentation_context_runway.interpretation: Calibration-learned decision-quality value of more observation is traded against shooter-visible runway without runtime oracle labels or actions.

l2_presentation_plan_reference.interpretation: Low confidence no longer drags the intended break point later. Consumed observed presentation instead reports lost connection runway and may force only the effective live connection later.

l3_finite_gun_reference.interpretation: Active engineering constraints only; values are not certified human limits and require Sense/video calibration and sensitivity analysis.

l3_no_learning_reference.interpretation: End-to-end no-learning route now fires finite-gun shots and scores only after action, but every predeclared initial static visual picture missed the 55 mm engineering centreline proxy. This negative result is preserved and is the starting point for hit/miss-only learning.

active_hypotheses: First-clear-sight epoch, expected presentation duration, demonstrated angular span, break-window coordinates and runway penalty remain provisional SHOTSIGHT_HYPOTHESIS values pending Sense/video calibration.
The source-informed L2 hold/connection/break coordinates are priors only and must compete with blank-slate/learned alternatives on actual motor/shot outcomes.
L3 begins with maintained lead as the cleanest controlled experiment; this is experimental sequencing, not a claim that maintained lead is universally best.
Human gun angular velocity, acceleration, jerk and reaction limits remain provisional; current plant limits are active calibration parameters rather than human facts.
Maintained-lead motor-delay feed-forward derived from perceived angular rate is a SHOTSIGHT_HYPOTHESIS controller feature, not a measured human strategy.
The next learner may explore angular target-gun visual relationships only inside the predeclared learner-safe action bounds; it must never receive the referee miss distance or exact ballistic answer.
negative_findings: Inherited canonical flat-crosser exposes exact intercept/physical lead and remains hidden oracle/reference truth only.
Current target engine and centreline evaluator are engineering proxies, not certified realistic clay aerodynamics, shot cloud or breakability.
Base L1 stable-crosser uncertainty was under-dispersed and required held-out calibration.
Poor 220 ms acquisition materially collapses crosser-versus-quarterer discrimination; uncertainty must be allowed to change behaviour.
Gravity-only looper recognition is too easy and is not real-looper validation.
An unconstrained L1 wait policy degenerated into waiting on every target; opportunity cost is required.
The original L2 0.12 s local planning coordinate was conceptually wrong for pre-call target planning.
A rolling 220 ms presentation context erased remembered target progress and was rejected.
Scalar confidence gain was a misleading surrogate for information value and was replaced by calibration Brier-loss improvement.
The old internal plan-structure proxy favoured blank-slate over source priors; it is bookkeeping only and prohibited as a success objective.
No Brett Winstanley hold/pickup/break claim is promoted without a recovered primary source.

The first finite gun controller can reach its provisional kinematic caps; learned shooting behaviour will therefore be sensitive to those engineering limits until real motion calibration is available.

The first L3 end-to-end baseline produced zero triggers because the fixed whole-presentation prior covered too little of the target and the trigger incorrectly gated on current prospective servo-command error; diagnostic seed bank 131000 was retired from held-out status after inspection.

After observation-only stand-prior calibration and visual-picture trigger repair, the initial 0-0.075 rad maintained-lead static separation sweep produced zero proxy hits on 24 untouched crossers despite valid triggers. Do not tune this away; learning must discover useful behaviour or expose an architectural failure.
next_action: Build L3 maintained-lead hit/miss-only learning with a simple interpretable memory policy before RL/neural methods. Use a broader predeclared angular visual-picture action grid within existing learner-safe bounds. Separate training/calibration/new held-out banks. After a trigger, expose only HIT_MISS_ONLY_FEEDBACK_V1 to the learner; never expose referee miss distance/vector, exact required lead, intercept, range or pellet TOF. Test whether sequential memory can discover non-zero proxy reward and improve unseen-target performance versus a no-memory control. If reward remains absent, preserve the failure and diagnose perception/motor/action-space architecture before adding compute or richer feedback.
